form.label: BigFix Compliance ETL Health & Performance
form.description: Monitors ETL task duration, item processing volume, and database cleanup operations.

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:bfc:import" "ETL Datasource task" "Success" | rex field=_raw "\(\+(?<duration>\d+:\d+:\d+\.\d+)\)\s+INFO:\s+ETL Datasource task: from Data Source -\s+(?<task_name>[^\(]+)" | eval task_name = trim(task_name) | search duration="*" task_name="*" | stats max(duration) AS "Max Duration (H:M:S)", latest(_time) AS "Latest Import" by task_name | rename task_name AS "ETL Task" | fieldformat "Latest Import" = strftime('Latest Import', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - "Max Duration (H:M:S)"

panel.title: Volume of Items Processed by Component

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:bfc:import" "items:" | rex field=_raw "INFO:\s+(?<component>[^\s]+)\s+items:\s+(?<item_count>\d+)" | search component="*" | stats sum(item_count) AS "Total Items", latest(_time) AS "Latest Import" by component | rename component AS "Compliance Component" | fieldformat "Latest Import" = strftime('Latest Import', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - "Total Items"

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:bfc:import" ERROR | rex field=_raw "ERROR:\s+(?<error_message>.*)" | eval error_message=coalesce(error_message, _raw) | stats count by error_message | rename error_message AS "Error Message", count AS "Occurrences" | sort - Occurrences
index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:bfc:import" "deleting orphaned check results" | timechart count AS "Orphaned Checks Deleted" span=1m
